headline: Consolidation measures have brought neither the expected recovery of public finances nor economic growth
summary: Slovakia's debt is climbing toward 92 billion euros despite three consolidation packages, the Supreme Audit Office warns. It puts debt per inhabitant at 16,700 euros.
why: Public debt levels and fiscal consolidation affect government bond yields, credit ratings and investor confidence in a country.
